architecture.locationStores: Two independent WordPress and WooCommerce installations; no WordPress Multisite
architecture.theme: Reusable Empire King theme shared by the corporate site and location stores
architecture.commerce: WooCommerce owns product, cart, and checkout behavior on location stores
architecture.durableBusinessLogic: Use a dedicated plugin when non-theme functionality is required
architecture.futureCorporateRouting: Every transactional Order, Menu, product, or deal action must ask for location before routing to a store

mediaArchitecture.productAndOperationalMedia: CMS-managed WordPress/WooCommerce media; do not hardcode production uploads
mediaArchitecture.temporaryPlaceholders: Clearly identify any temporary development placeholder when one is introduced
mediaArchitecture.mediaCounts: Not established; do not invent counts
